description: The CGTMSE homepage states a minimum guarantee fee (0.37% p.a.) and a maximum guarantee coverage ceiling (₹10 crore), but does not publish a full fee slab (fees typically vary by loan size, women/NER/Aspirational- district status, and MLI category) or a guarantee coverage percentage. This vault note records only what the fetched homepage actually states; the complete fee structure lives in a linked scheme-guidelines document that has not been fetched yet.
public_disclosure_en: This assistant has confirmed CGTMSE's minimum guarantee fee (0.37% per annum) and maximum guarantee coverage ceiling (₹10 crore) from CGTMSE's own website, but the complete fee slab by loan size and borrower category has not yet been verified from a primary source. For an exact fee applicable to your loan, confirm with your lending institution or CGTMSE directly.
public_disclosure_hi: इस सहायक ने CGTMSE की न्यूनतम गारंटी फीस (0.37% प्रति वर्ष) और अधिकतम गारंटी कवरेज सीमा (₹10 करोड़) की पुष्टि CGTMSE की अपनी वेबसाइट से की है, लेकिन ऋण राशि और उधारकर्ता श्रेणी के अनुसार पूर्ण फीस संरचना अभी तक किसी प्राथमिक स्रोत से सत्यापित नहीं की गई है। अपने ऋण पर लागू सटीक फीस के लिए, कृपया अपनी ऋणदाता संस्था या CGTMSE से सीधे पुष्टि करें।
